about: Realistic clean program: every finding on it is false. Scored for rules only. `why` gives, per instruction, why each account is safely validated. Config / Pool / Position / PoolStats are Anchor accounts (owner = this program + discriminator on every load).

why.admin: Signer, and program_data.upgrade_authority_address == Some(admin) (Unauthorized): only the upgrade authority can run the one-time setup.
why.config: init at the constant PDA [config]: exists once, cannot be re-initialized.
why.program: Program<StakingPool> (this program's id, executable), and programdata_address() == program_data (InvalidProgramData).
why.program_data: Account<ProgramData>: owned by the upgradeable loader, deserialized; bound to this program by the constraint above.

why.config: PDA [config] with stored bump, has_one = admin (Unauthorized).
PDA [config]; constraint config.pending_admin == new_admin (NotPendingAdmin). pending_admin is reset to the default key, which nobody can sign for.
why.new_admin: Signer: two-step rotation, the proposed key must sign.

why.admin: Signer, compared with config.admin by the only_admin helper (require_keys_eq!, Unauthorized) before the write.
Signer, config has_one = admin: only the admin creates pools (and pays their rent).
why.stake_mint / reward_mint: Account<Mint> (SPL Token owned, unpacked); reward_mint != stake_mint (SameMint).
why.pool: init at PDA [pool, stake_mint]: one pool per stake mint, fresh.
why.stake_vault / reward_vault: init at PDAs [stake_vault|reward_vault, pool] as token accounts of the pool's mints with the pool PDA as authority.

why.pool: PDA [pool, pool.stake_mint] with the stored bump; accrued before the rate changes; rate bounded.

why.payer: Signer, pays the rent. Permissionless by design (payer-funded init).
why.owner: Any wallet (UncheckedAccount): only its key is stored and seeds the PDA, so the position can only ever be used by that wallet; creating it for someone else only costs the payer the rent.
why.position: init at PDA [position, pool, owner]: fresh, one per (pool, owner).
PDA [position, pool, owner] / bump; has_one = owner, has_one = pool.
why.owner: Signer (position owner; also the transfer authority).
why.user_stake: token::mint = pool.stake_mint, token::authority = owner (the token program also requires the owner's signature).

why.pool: PDA / bump; has_one = stake_vault, has_one = stake_mint; signs the vault transfers with its own seeds.
why.position: PDA [position, pool, owner]; has_one owner / pool; amount <= position.amount.
why.user_stake: token::mint = stake_mint; any token account the owner picks (the owner withdraws its own stake).
why.treasury_token: associated_token (mint = stake_mint, authority = config.treasury): the fee can only go to the configured treasury's ATA.

why.pool: PDA / bump; has_one = reward_vault; signs the payout.
why.position: PDA [position, pool, owner]; has_one owner / pool. Pays min(pending, vault balance), saturating.
why.user_reward: token::mint = pool.reward_mint; the owner's choice of destination.
why.stats: zero-copy AccountLoader at PDA [stats, pool] / pool.stats_bump (owner + discriminator on load_mut).

why.funder: Signer; permissionless by design: anyone may donate rewards from its own account.
why.funder_token: token::mint = pool.reward_mint, token::authority = funder (and the token program requires the funder's signature).

why.cranker: Signer, fee payer only: permissionless by design (moves the reward index to the current time, which every other instruction does too).
why.stats: zero-copy at PDA [stats, pool] / pool.stats_bump. head is a ring-buffer cursor (wrapping_add by design, used modulo 16), not a value.

why.pool: PDA / bump. Permissionless: settles accrued rewards into each position's pending, exactly what the owner's own stake / unstake / claim would do; moves no tokens.
why.remaining accounts: each one: owner == this program, writable, Account<Position>::try_from (discriminator), position.pool == pool (InvalidPosition). A position passed twice settles 0 the second time (reward_debt updated and written by exit).

why.owner: Signer, has_one = owner; receives the rent (close = owner).
why.position: Account<Position>, has_one = owner, close = owner (Anchor close: lamports moved, discriminator overwritten); amount == 0 and pending == 0 (PositionNotEmpty).
